distribution.method: Independent projected-NDF half-slope radial quadrature with analytic azimuth arcs; Lambert and roughness1 analytic anchors. Energy integrates D-cancelled physical Smith BRDF; white dielectric mixture adds Schlick Fresnel and analytic diffuse integral. Histogram 16 equal-z bins times four sign quadrants plus null. Bonferroni Bernstein confidence assumes iid pseudorandom input variates. Numerical quadrature envelopes are refinement estimates, not rigorous interval bounds.
distribution.scope: VNDF candidate only; Lambert, pure white conductor and one white dielectric mixture. Mixture weight bound4, others1.0003. No universal mixed-material energy claim, no legacy NDF discrepancy clearance, no rendered temporal quality claim. Custom validation counters cover post-device-initialization through resource cleanup, not instance creation/destruction; external whole-process log verification remains required.
